correctness.rationale: On the orthonormal Laurent basis the coordinate shift satisfies a_j=(1+q^{j+1})/(1+q^j) and b_j=(1+q^{j+2})/(1+q^j), with (1+q)a_j-b_j=q. The defect diagonal telescopes into q Delta_j-b_j Delta_{j+1}. For the piecewise-linear tent the unique central coefficient dominates all endpoints including N=1, giving the exact norm. Toeplitz boundary averages alpha/beta control all diagonal entries by convex combination; limits at j→±infty force both <=distance and the peak forces distance>=1/2. I/2 gives equality. Thus uniform norm error bound is impossible.
